package.name: moil_interfaces
package.description:
The contract between the MoilCali server and its remote clients: axis motion and sensors, camera capture, the calibration monitors, the whole compute pipeline, the session store, 3D verification, and the long cancellable jobs.
The twelve axis and monitor definitions are byte-identical to V2.0.0's, so the two generations interoperate for everything they cover. The rest is surface for work that used to run inside the client and now runs on the rig.
